# ABC-12345 — Publish account events in the new format

https://jira.example.com/browse/ABC-12345

## Goals

- Publish account events in the new REST format
- Keep the existing XML feed running in parallel
- Write the two formats into separate topics

## Current situation

### billing-core

This service writes outbox rows. One row per account change, with type ACCOUNT.

The row is written in the same transaction as the account itself.

### billing-dispatch

In a loop:

- read the next unpublished rows
- push them to the broker
- delete the rows

## Solution design

Message:

- add the field entityType

```java
record AccountEvent(String id, EntityType type) {}
```

| Field | Required |
| --- | --- |
| id | yes |
| type | yes |

See [the broker notes](https://wiki.example.com/brokers) and ![topology.png](attachments/topology.png)

## Conditions of Satisfaction

- every message carries entityType
- dispatch rejects rows whose type is not ACCOUNT
